name: container_low_cpu_utilization
title: Container Low CPU utilization
description: Container CPU utilization is under 20% for 1 week. Consider reducing the allocated CPU.

source.upstream_query: (sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!=""}[5m])) by (pod, container) / sum(container_spec_cpu_quota{container!=""}/container_spec_cpu_period{container!=""}) by (pod, container) * 100) < 20 and sum(container_spec_cpu_quota{container!=""}/container_spec_cpu_period{container!=""}) by (pod, container) > 0
source.upstream_description: Container CPU utilization is under 20% for 1 week. Consider reducing the allocated CPU. (current: {{ $value | printf "%.2f" }}%)
source.period_clamped_from: Upstream `for` is 7d (10080 minutes); the evaluation window is capped at 60 minutes. Widen trigger_condition.period if you want the full upstream window.
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

query_condition.promql: ((sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!=""}[5m])) by (pod, container) / sum(container_spec_cpu_quota{container!=""}/container_spec_cpu_period{container!=""}) by (pod, container) * 100) < 20 and sum(container_spec_cpu_quota{container!=""}/container_spec_cpu_period{container!=""}) by (pod, container) > 0) * 0 + 1
